title: Fix Auth Session Persistence
description: After clicking magic link, user should stay logged in. Currently session doesn't persist - user is prompted to login again when navigating.

symptoms: Click magic link -> redirected but not logged in
Header doesn't show Dashboard/Sign Out buttons
Session cookie not being set or read correctly

acceptanceCriteria.text: Investigate why session cookies aren't persisting after magic link verification
Check Better Auth session configuration (cookie settings, secure, sameSite)
After clicking magic link, user lands on /dashboard AND stays logged in
Header shows 'Dashboard' and 'Sign Out' buttons when logged in
Navigating between pages maintains logged-in state
Sign Out button works and clears session
